quarterly_data.quarter: Inficon press release: INFICON delivers record second quarter 2026 and raises full-year guidance (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: INFICON (release): record Q2 2026 sales of USD 198.1 million, up 9.5% sequentially and 18.3% year on year (organic: 17.4%), with leading-edge logic, high-bandwidth memory and data-center infrastructure as the primary demand drivers; Semiconductor & Vacuum Coating sales were USD 107.3 million (+30.7% year on year, 54.2% of group sales); gross margin 46.6% and operating income USD 42.3 million (21.3% margin); H1 2026 sales USD 379.1 million (+16.4%) with an 18.9% operating margin.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 sales USD 198.1 million (+18.3%); semiconductor sales USD 107.3 million (+30.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: INFICON (release): order intake reached an all-time high in Q2 2026, with a book-to-bill ratio well above 1.

quarterly_data.quarter: Inficon press release: INFICON delivers record second quarter 2026 and raises full-year guidance (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: INFICON (release): full-year 2026 guidance raised to sales of USD 750-780 million (previously USD 710-750 million) and an operating income margin of 19-20% (previously 18-20%), based on the strong half year, continued strong order intake and the accelerating semiconductor cycle.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 sales USD 750-780 million; operating margin 19-20%
